item.title: Weaponizing Migration: People as a Battering Ram
item.description: A cornered dictator has found a weapon no missile shield can stop: human beings themselves. By luring desperate migrants and force-marching them at a democracy's border, an autocrat manufactures a humanitarian catastrophe whose corpses are the point — a 21st-century state terrorism that turns the target's own humanism into the channel of attack. The answer is neither appeasement nor xenophobic panic, because humanism is not idiocy and Europe is not lost — it is being attacked.
